name: Blazing Spirit
text:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger A creature damages you with a melee attack.

Requirements Your attuned apparition grants Battlegrounds Lore or Volcano Lore as an apparition skill.

---
Your apparition grants fiery defenses. You gain resistance equal to your level against the triggering damage, and the triggering creature takes ternary(gte(@actor.level,18,3,ternarygte(@actor.level,12,2,1)))d6 fire,ternary(gte(@actor.level,18,3,ternarygte(@actor.level,12,2,1))) persistent,fire damage. This damage increases to 2d6 fire damage and 2 persistent fire damage at 12th level, and 3d6 fire damage and 3 persistent fire damage at 18th level.
